prompt: A company runs batch jobs that can restart if interrupted, and it wants the lowest cost. Which option fits?

options.explanation: Correct. Spot Instances suit interruptible work at a large discount.
On-Demand has no discount for interruptible work.
Dedicated Hosts are for dedicated hardware needs.
These guarantee capacity and carry no discount of their own.

explanation: Interruptible and low cost point to Spot Instances.

prompt: A company will run a short project with unpredictable usage and wants no long-term commitment. Which option fits?

options.explanation: Correct. On-Demand has no upfront payment or long-term commitment.
This requires a long commitment.
This requires a one or three year commitment.
Nothing in the scenario calls for dedicated hardware.

explanation: Short and unpredictable points to On-Demand.

prompt: A company has steady compute use across several instance families and Regions, and also uses AWS Lambda. It can commit for a year. Which option fits?

options.explanation: Correct. They apply across families and Regions, and to Fargate and Lambda.
These can be interrupted and do not cover this steady need.
This is tied to one Availability Zone.
These offer no discount for a commitment.

explanation: Compute Savings Plans offer the most flexibility.

prompt: Which type of data transfer has no charge?

options.text: Inbound data from the internet to AWS
options.explanation: Correct. Inbound transfer has no charge.
Outbound internet transfer is charged.
Cross-Region transfer is charged.
Cross-AZ transfer is charged.

explanation: Data coming in is free. Data going out or across boundaries is usually charged.

options.text: A billing discount applied to matching usage
options.explanation: Correct. It is not a physical instance.

options.text: A physical server set aside for the customer
options.explanation: That is closer to a Dedicated Host.

options.text: A backup copy of an instance
options.explanation: Reserved Instances are not backups.

options.text: A free instance for new customers
options.explanation: Reserved Instances are paid commitments.

explanation: Reserved Instances give a discount in return for a one or three year term.
